items.t: Passenger airbag inflator can rupture (Takata recall)
Crank or cam sensor can make the engine stall (recall)
items.job: Replace crankshaft and camshaft position sensors (recall)
items.note: If the recall was already done and a sensor fails again, a sensor costs roughly $50-$150 plus about an hour of labor.

items.t: Ignition coils fail and cause misfires
items.note: RepairPal lists about $567-$618 total. The rear coils sit under the intake plenum, which adds labor.

items.t: Long cranking or hard starting, often when warm
items.job: Diagnose no-start and replace crank or cam sensor
items.note: Cost depends on the part found at fault; a relay or ground cable costs less, a starter more.

items.t: Excessive oil consumption or oil sludge
items.job: Replace engine with used or remanufactured unit
items.note: Owners reported an average of about $6,000 for sludge-related engine failure; a used engine is cheaper. Catching oil burning early can avoid this.

items.t: Catalytic converter fails
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,520-$1,600 for most years; California-legal converters cost more.

items.t: Worn engine mounts cause vibration and clunks
items.note: RepairPal lists about $1,220-$1,300 for 2000-2001; replacing one mount costs less.

items.t: Radiator cracks and leaks coolant
Power steering hose leaks
Alternator stops charging
Knock sensor code and check engine light
items.note: RepairPal lists about $435-$490 for 1996-1999 and $750-$950 for 2000-2001; the intake manifold has to come off.

items.t: Mass airflow sensor failure
items.note: A genuine Infiniti/Hitachi sensor is at the top of the range; RepairPal lists over $1,000 for the I35 with a dealer part.

items.t: Check engine light from EVAP valve or leak
items.job: Replace EVAP purge or vent valve
items.note: A smoke test to find the leak adds about an hour.

items.t: Rough or surging idle and stalling
items.job: Clean throttle body and idle air control valve, idle relearn
items.note: If the electronic throttle body itself has failed on a 2002-2004 I35, RepairPal lists about $1,070-$1,120.

items.t: Clunk or click from the front when turning
items.job: Replace front strut assemblies and mounts (pair)
items.note: Owners report about $1,300 for front struts, mounts and rear shocks together.

items.t: Front lower control arm pin can break (recall)
Gas pedal can over-travel and limit engine speed (recall)
Oxygen sensors fail
Oil leaks from valve cover or oil pan gaskets
items.job: Replace valve cover gaskets and plug tube seals
items.note: The rear valve cover needs the intake plenum removed, which adds time.

items.t: CV axle clicks when turning
Brake caliper sticks
Starter clicks or won't crank
